name: agent-skills
description: Generic specialist skills and agents (architecture, QA, UX/UI, docs, requirements, security, performance) and cheap offload workers that complement Superpowers and Playwright.

offload_policy.title: Offload table at session start
offload_policy.description: Loads the offload table (about 2800 characters) at session start, after /clear and after a compaction, and skips itself when ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md already holds the table. Turn it off when the table reaches the session another way (a project CLAUDE.md, an imported file, account instructions).
